result_summary: 442 PASS and 0 FAIL. New coverage verifies initial not-presented state, activate() calling show once, repeated activate() being a no-op, dismiss() clearing state, and reactivation after dismiss.
limitations: Overlay behavior is exercised through an injected mock; real NSWindow creation and key/mouse event dismissal are not covered by the unit test.
NSMenu placement is verified by implementation review and build rather than a dedicated AppKit menu snapshot test.
